# Ecocee

> Ecocee is an engineering and technology company based in Ernakulam, Kerala, India. It builds custom AI agents, private AI infrastructure, embedded and IoT hardware, and publishes Kode, an open source programming language.

Ecocee takes ambitious ideas and engineers them into real systems across three domains:
1. Intelligence: Custom AI agents, local models, and workflow automation for businesses.
2. Software & Infrastructure: Private on-premise AI deployments and backend systems.
3. Connected Hardware: Embedded systems, custom firmware, edge devices, and sensor networks.

Contact: info@ecocee.in | Website: https://ecocee.in

---

## Kode: The Programming Language

Kode is an open source compiled programming language created by Ecocee. It combines clean, expressive syntax with static typing and an LLVM backend to produce small, fast native binaries (~302 KB stripped). It is built for cloud backends, systems programming, and AI agents.

- Version: 0.3.6 (ABI 0006)
- Compiler: Written in Rust, LLVM backend, reference-counted memory with leak detection
- Pipeline: source → lexer → parser → AST → type check → MIR → LLVM IR → clang → object → linker → binary
- Quality: 223 passed, 0 failed (cargo test --workspace)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Build Requirements: Rust 1.91+ and a C compiler (on macOS: xcode-select --install)
- Platform Support: Linux (x86-64), macOS (ARM64). Windows support is currently available as a preview.
- Repository: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode
- README: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/README.md
- Documentation: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/tree/main/docs
- License file: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/LICENSE
- Contributing: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Security Policy: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Discussions: https://github.com/ecocee/Kode/discussions
